title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.34073v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value. Taking RAG as a reference, we dissect the net value of memory into the gains and losses over direct retrieval, termed memory benefit and memory tax. These gains and losses arise because memory process changes how the raw information is organized and accessed. We view such changes as the double-edged deviations from the raw history. They are originally designed and introduced to benefit the task, for example by reorganizing facts or distilling preferences, but some may also remove or obscure evidence, giving rise to memory tax. translated_title: 记忆税：剖析智能体记忆的净价值
translated_abstract: 记忆在长时程智能体中的应用日益增多，然而与直接从原始历史记录中检索相比，构建记忆的净价值在很大程度上仍不明确。通过跨多个基准测试和多种模型骨干的大规模评估，我们发现许多专用记忆系统在许多情况下表现不如朴素的RAG，表明其净价值为负。以RAG为参照，我们将记忆的净价值分解为相对于直接检索的收益与损失，分别称为“记忆收益”和“记忆税”。这些收益与损失之所以产生，是因为记忆处理过程改变了原始信息的组织与访问方式。我们将这些改变视为对原始历史的“双刃剑”式偏差：它们最初是为有益于任务而设计和引入的，例如重组事实或提炼偏好，但有些也可能移除或掩盖证据，从而产生记忆税。由于记忆收益反映了其设计的预期收益，我们随后……
tldr: 该论文提出将智能体记忆的净价值分解为“记忆收益”与“记忆税”的分析框架，并通过大规模评估揭示许多专用记忆系统的表现不如朴素RAG（净价值为负），其根源在于记忆处理对原始信息的组织与访问方式的改变是一把双刃剑。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes dissecting the net value of agent memory into "memory benefit" and "memory tax," revealing through large-scale evaluation that many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG, as memory processing's deviations from raw history are a double-edged sword that can both reorganize useful information and remove or obscure critical evidence.
